visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Smallest First Instead of Largest First
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The values should come out largest first (8 5 3 2 1), but they come out smallest first.

solution.explanation: By default a PriorityQueue is a min-heap: the natural order of the numbers decides, so the smallest is polled first. A reversed comparator turns it into a max-heap.
